en.title: Which Water Town from Shanghai: Zhujiajiao, Tongli or Wuzhen?
en.headline: Choose One Water Town from Shanghai: Zhujiajiao, Tongli or Wuzhen
en.description: Compare transfer friction, gardens, living-town texture, managed night scenery and overnight value without pretending the three towns are interchangeable.

zh.title: 上海出发选哪个水乡：朱家角、同里还是乌镇？
zh.headline: 从上海只选一个水乡：朱家角、同里或乌镇
zh.description: 比较交通摩擦、园林、生活感、夜景经营与过夜价值，不把三座水乡当成同一种体验。

ko.title: 상하이 근교 수향: 주자자오·퉁리·우전
